brief.headline: Push price toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc for the 28 mm cap (market says ₹0.55–1.20, typical ₹0.85–0.95) and line up Manjushree Technopack as a second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for pricing closer to ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap
priceAsk.target: ₹0.65–0.80/pc (the lower end of the market typical band ₹0.85–0.95/pc, achievable at higher volume or looser spec per market research)
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows the 28 mm cap asks range ₹0.55–1.20/pc, with typical at ₹0.85–0.95/pc and headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at scale — we spend ₹58.17 L annually, giving us volume to justify the lower band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt — no extension

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj Blow Plast publishes no financials, so we cannot see their revenue, profit, or how tight their cash is. That means our negotiating power rests on three things: our ₹58.17 L annual spend, the clear market benchmark showing room to move (₹0.65–0.80/pc is fair at volume), and the five credible alternates we can qualify. Without visibility into their books, we keep the conversation on price and supply security, not on their finances.

evidence.point: Market research shows the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap typically asks ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
